mapper.select: SELECT o.*, c.display_name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE o.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY o.placed_at DESC
SELECT c.*, (SELECT SUM(o.total_cents) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id) AS spend FROM customers c WHERE c.country = #{country} ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status} WHERE CAST(customer_id AS TEXT) = #{reference}
